message: No detected input validation: The code uses yaml.safe_load and check_dataset/check_img_size helpers, but there are no explicit schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data at the acquisition stage.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code calls attempt_download from google_utils and loads weights/data files, but there is no checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned revision check on any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the visible data preparation flow.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights via `attempt_load(weights, map_location=device)` and `torch.load(weights)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision check.

No detected label distribution validation: The code calls check_dataset() and plot_labels() but these are dataset integrity/path checks and visualization utilities, not explicit class balance or label distribution anomaly checks before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense mechanism anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or any DP mechanism is imported or used in the training code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: The evaluation code uses standard YOLOv5 validation (mAP, NMS) with no adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests present anywhere in the snippet.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforced by code, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metric sources; the evaluation simply runs inference on whatever dataset path is provided with no integrity checks.

No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model output probabilities for NaN values, out-of-range confidence scores, or other sanity bounds before returning results; NMS thresholds are applied but these are filtering parameters, not defensive output validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a YOLOv5 computer vision model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
